test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate title for the given passage

options.text: Statistics of the Union of India

solution:
The correct answer is **Statistics of the Union of India**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the economic statistics of different states in India, showing the disparity in their incomes.
 
• It provides detailed statistical evidence and historical comparisons over two distinct periods (1989-90 and 2019-20).
 
• The passage also highlights the implications of this income divergence, including political and economic consequences.
 
• Given the detailed statistical data and the discussion on income disparity among states, the most fitting title is "**Statistics of the Union of India**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "The Poor and their Income,"** - While the passage discusses income disparity, it focuses more broadly on the statistics of different states rather than solely on the poor.
 
• **Option 3: "Population in India,"** - Population growth is mentioned, but it is not the central theme of the passage.
 
• **Option 4: "Indian Politics,"** - This option does not accurately reflect the focus on economic statistics and income differences among states.
